description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map7_s01.why_im_still_alive_even:
{wait1 4.0}Why I'm still alive even
though everyone else's dead.
strings.map7_s01.im_not_the_only_one:
{wait1 4.0}I'm not the only one
who's still walking around.
strings.map7_s01.investigation_stalled_ptv:
{pos 4}{color 3}Investigation stalled.
[PTV] dealers still at large.

Suspicious deaths continue.
Like the anti-drug mayor,
a narcotics officer dies of
a sudden heart failure of
unknown origin.{end}
strings.map7_s01.are_there_others_its_pretty:
Are there others?
It's pretty old...
strings.map7_s01.fire_broke_out_in_town:
{pos 4}{color 3}Fire broke out in town.
6 homes destroyed.

Charred body
of Alessa Gillespie(7)
found in aftermath.

Cause of fire currently under
investigation.
strings.map7_s01.investigations_show_source_as:
{pos 4}{color 3}Investigations show source
as basement of Gillespie home.
Blaze now believed caused by
malfunction of antiquated
boiler.{end}
strings.map7_s01.its_the_same_day_we:
it's the same day
we found Cheryl!{end}
strings.map7_s01.theres_a_place_mark_in:
There's a place mark
in the book...{end}
strings.map7_s01.white_claudia_perennial_herb:
{pos 4}{color 3}WHITE CLAUDIA.

Perennial herb found near water.
Reaches height of 10 to 15 in.
Oblong leaves, white blossoms.
strings.map7_s01.seeds_contain_hallucinogen:
{pos 4}{color 3}Seeds contain hallucinogen.
Ancient records show it was
used for religious ceremonies.
The hallucinogenic effect
was key.{end}
strings.map7_s01.the_room_is_filled_with:
{pos 4}{color 3}The room is filled with insects.

Even with doors
and windows shut
they get in to spite me.

To the hospital...{end}
strings.map7_s01.still_alive_but_with_wounds:
{pos 4}{color 3}Still alive,
but with wounds that won't heal.{end}
strings.map7_s01.blood_and_pus_flow_from:
{pos 4}{color 3}Blood and pus flow from
the bathroom faucet.

I try to stop it,
but it won't turn off.{end}
strings.map7_s01.feeling_bad_need_to_throw:
{pos 4}{color 3}Feeling bad.
Need to throw up.
But nothing comes out.
Vomiting only bile.{end}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_ring_of:
There is a {color 2}Ring of contract{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_bird_cage:
There is a {color 2}Bird cage key{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_stone_of:
There is a {color 2}Stone of time{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_key_of:
There is a {color 2}Key of [Ophiel]{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_key_of_2:
There is a {color 2}Key of [Hagith]{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_key_of_3:
There is a {color 2}Key of [Phaleg]{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_an_amulet_of:
There is an {color 2}Amulet of Solomon{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_crest_of:
There is a {color 2}Crest of Mercury{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map7_s01.old_clock_there_is_a:
Old clock.
There is a square hole
in the center of the clock.
strings.map7_s01.the_hands_of_the_clock:
The hands of the clock
...it's a key.
strings.map7_s01.i_cant_get_to_it:
I can't get to it because
of the glass cover.{end}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_key_in: There is a key in the faucet,
strings.map7_s01.but_i_cant_get_it:
but I can't get it out no matter
how much I pull.{end}
strings.map7_s01.names_engraved_on_a_lithograph:
{color 3}Names engraved
On a lithograph.
The Grim Reaper's list.
strings.map7_s01.yes_the_headcount_is_set:
{color 3}Yes, the headcount is set
Young and old lined up
In order of age.
strings.map7_s01.electricity_is_flowing_to_the:
Electricity is flowing to the key.
I'll get shocked if I grab it now.{end}
strings.map7_s01.the_word_ophiel_is_carved:
The word, [Ophiel]
is carved on the door.{end}
strings.map7_s01.the_word_hagith_is_carved:
The word, [Hagith]
is carved on the door.{end}
strings.map7_s01.the_word_phaleg_is_carved:
The word, [Phaleg]
is carved on the door.{end}
strings.map7_s01.a_steel_plate_is_screwed:
A steel plate
is screwed to the wall.{end}
strings.map7_s01.the_elevator_doesnt_appear_to:
The elevator doesn't
appear to be working.{end}
strings.map7_s01.theres_a_clock_with_a:
There's a clock
with a broken face.{end}
strings.map7_s01.none_of_this_stuff_is: None of this stuff is of any use.{end}
strings.map7_s01.there_is_a_diary_on: There is a diary on the floor.{end}
strings.map7_s01.looks_like_an_altar_wonder:
Looks like an altar.
Wonder what they worship?{end}
strings.map7_s01.a_body_is_laid_out:
A body is laid out on the bed.
Don't feel like checking this out.{end}
